featured_reviews.name: TheWolfman'sBrother
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Dazzle Dental Clinic for tooth sensitivity and was extremely happy with the treatment. The doctor recommended onlays/crowns, and the results were excellent.

What really stood out was the care and attention to detail. The doctor took extra time to ensure my bite was perfectly aligned and made sure I was fully comfortable throughout the process.

Punctual appointments, a clean and well-maintained clinic, and hygienic washrooms added to the overall positive experience. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Bhairavi Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t thank Dr. Laud enough for the exceptional care he provided. It’s rare to find a doctor who is as caring and committed to his patients as he is!

I took my 68 year old aunt to him for a wisdom tooth extraction, and from start to finish, he went above and beyond to make sure she was comfortable by explaining every step to her, which really helped calm her nerves.
No matter the time of day, he was always available to answer any questions we had, especially after the extraction. He even checked in on her daily to see how she was recovering.

His clinic is also stunning with state-of-the-art equipment, which makes the whole experience even better. His staff was also incredibly friendly and courteous.
Dr. Laud treats his patients like family, and that kind of care is hard to come by. So, if you’re looking for a dentist who is both skilled and genuinely compassionate, I highly recommend him.

Thank you so much, Dr. Laud, for everything!
